functions.formula: IOn = latch n when ENABLE' AND READ1' AND READ2' AND WRITE1 AND WRITE2; otherwise Z
functions.text: The I/O pins drive the stored byte only when ENABLE and both READ inputs are low and both WRITE inputs are high (read). Otherwise they float and act as inputs.

rules: CLEAR H, ENABLE L, READ L, WRITE H: enter L into all latches, bus shows L
CLEAR H, ENABLE L, READ L, WRITE L: enter L, bus Hi-Z
CLEAR L, ENABLE L, READ H, WRITE H: do nothing, bus Hi-Z
CLEAR L, ENABLE H: do nothing, bus Hi-Z
CLEAR L, ENABLE L, WRITE L: write, latches take the bus levels
CLEAR L, ENABLE L, READ L, WRITE H: read, bus shows the latches

In the truth table READ and WRITE mean "both READ inputs" / "both WRITE inputs"; behaviour with the two READ (or two WRITE) pins at different levels is not stated.
notes: The IO pins are both inputs and three-state outputs; given role output with a text note.
